title: I Tried the Costco Gold Hack (How Much I Actually Made)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

speakers.name: Dallas Gold and Silver Exchange representative (name not stated)
Frisco Gold Buyers representative (name not stated)

promo_conflict: CollectPure is recommended as the sales marketplace and Braden’s tutorial and resources are promoted; no financial relationship is disclosed.

stated_problem.quote: But, as we just saw, we can't sell this gold locally because local buyers are not willing to pay enough for it. We need a much bigger market.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Costco gold bar online resale arbitrage
idea.one_liner: Buy gold bars from Costco, list them for individual buyers on a precious-metals marketplace, and seek profit from resale pricing and rewards.
idea.customer: Individual buyers purchasing precious metals online through CollectPure.
idea.offer: Costco gold bars resold through an online precious-metals marketplace with authenticity checks and escrow.
idea.revenue_model: Resale spread plus credit-card and Costco rewards; the transcript does not show the completed sale or realized profit.

key_quotes.quote: And so, this website, Collect Pure, they're a marketplace. Picture eBay if it were only for buying and selling precious metals.
So, we're not selling to Collect Pure, we're selling to another individual that's buying through Collect Pure.
I list it for sale on CollectPure. Once it sells, they send me a shipping label, and I go to FedEx, as you see here.
CollectPure receives it, they unpack it, they validate it, they repack it, they pay me, they ship it to the eventual buyer, everyone's happy.
CollectPure takes a little bit of a profit in between, and then you do it over and over again.

claims.claim: The video says people make $2,000 to $20,000 profit per week from this method.
claims.quote: There's about 900 of them on this big [music] blue earth, and people are making between $2,000 and $20,000 profit every week buying gold bars from Costco and selling them on the internet.

claims.claim: The Dallas–Fort Worth area has about 14 Costcos.
claims.quote: So there are about 14 Costcos in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, and we want to see if any of them have any gold.

claims.claim: A Costco employee reported 24 bars in stock at the time of the call.
claims.quote: 24 of them. We have plenty.

claims.claim: The speaker says buying five bars requires five disguises.
claims.quote: If you want to buy five bars, you just need to disguise every time. You need five disguises in the car.

claims.claim: A Costco employee said the bars sold out within an hour the prior week.
claims.quote: They sold out within the hour last week.

claims.claim: A Costco employee says the limit is five per day and describes a customer buying ten with a business membership too.
claims.quote: Like that lady who I sold she bought 10 like that's our limit is five a day, but you know, she had a business membership, too.

claims.claim: The employee estimated the customer was carrying $50,000 worth of gold.
claims.quote: I'm like, she's walking with 50k in her pocket.

claims.claim: The employee recalls Costco first selling the gold about two and a half years earlier for 1749.
claims.quote: when we first got it like two and a half years ago, it was a we have six it was 1749.

claims.claim: The speaker says he bought a bar for $4,209 in the test transaction.
claims.quote: All right, so I just picked up some gold here, $4,209.

claims.claim: The speaker aimed to find a local buyer who would pay about 4150.
claims.quote: we need to see if we can find a local gold buyer to buy it from us for about 4150.

claims.claim: A local buyer quoted $3,976.41 for the bar.
claims.quote: Right now is we would buy it from you for $3,976.41.

claims.claim: The speaker says 3,946, then asks whether an online site could sell it for 4150-ish.
claims.quote: Oh, 3,946. So, we can go online to a certain website and sell this for 4150-ish?

claims.claim: The speaker also floats 4160 as an online sale price.
claims.quote: So, we can go online to a certain website and sell this for 4150-ish? 4160?

claims.claim: The speaker estimates $30 overnight shipping is worthwhile for a product worth 100 times that.
claims.quote: And if you pay $30 to overnight something via FedEx, it's well worth it when the product is 100 times that.

claims.claim: The speaker says rewards on the gold can reach 7%.
claims.quote: You can earn up to 7% on this gold.

claims.claim: The speaker says a credit card can provide 3% back and names the Venmo card.
claims.quote: 3% from your credit card. The Venmo card is great for this.

claims.claim: Some credit cards may offer 3% grocery cash back if Costco is categorized as a grocery purchase.
claims.quote: Or, you can use credit cards that offer 3% cash back on groceries, assuming that they categorize Costco as a grocery purchase, because not all credit cards do.

claims.claim: The speaker says credit-card and Costco rewards combine to about 5%.
claims.quote: So, that's 3% from the credit card, 2% back from Costco, we're at five

claims.claim: An unnamed service is said to add 2% back for paying a credit card with a debit card, bringing the total to about 7%.
claims.quote: a special company that enables you to pay off a credit card with a debit card and get 2% back in the process, which makes this a total of about 7%

claims.claim: The speaker estimates losing 1 to 2% when selling the gold.
claims.quote: So, you're going to lose 1 to 2% right off the bat when you sell the gold.

claims.claim: The speaker estimates 5 to 7% in rewards, netting about 5% cash back overall.
claims.quote: But then hopefully, you're going to make between 5 and 7% from all the cashback rewards, which will net you out at about 5% cashback total.

acquisition_channels.details: Lists the bar on CollectPure for individual buyers; the marketplace handles validation, escrow, payment, and onward shipping.

ideas.delivery: The founder checks Costco stock, buys and handles the physical bar, lists it online, packs and ships it through FedEx, and keeps records. CollectPure validates the bar, holds funds in escrow, pays the seller, and ships it to the buyer.

prices: 3,946 local price stated by the speaker
5–7% estimated rewards; about 5% estimated net cash back

ideas.other_uk_rules: No subscriptions, staffing or customer-data practices are described, so the DMCC Act subscription rules, Employment Agencies Regulations 2003 and UK GDPR are not materially addressed. UK precious-metal and VAT treatment is not discussed.
